records.title: perf(lsp): LoaderDefault workspaces carry the resolved default-base SHA
records.release_claim: default-base workspaces deduplicate and identify analysis against the exact resolved base commit
records.reason: Resolving Git inputs once is incomplete if LoaderDefault records only the symbolic/default intent; movement of the selected base must defeat dedup and change snapshot identity.
records.non_claim: The default-base selection algorithm remains the existing fail-closed loader policy.
